maria: Starting q6b-int4-v2 bring-up on staging. Need promptset curation + golden checks before any traffic. Focus: instruction, codegen, RAG long-context. Can we assess overlap and labeler capacity? ping @alex @jonathan @sara

alex: I'll run overlap scan. How big is the canary and what's our acceptable quality delta?

maria: Canary = 5k stratified (50% instr, 25% code, 25% RAG). Accept <=1.5% drop on golden pass rate. Latency ~+25% throughput in perf runs.

jonathan: Overlap quick-pass: ~28% near-dupes at cos>0.92. Risk losing rare intents if we dedupe hard. Suggest: cutoff 0.97 for samples tagged rare_intent, else 0.92. I'll share script.

sara: Label ops: queue 1,189, 3 annotators, ~200/day. We can prioritize 500 canary items if we freeze other work. Someone should open golden-update PR to lock set.

kevin: Bench: overall latency improved, but instruction subset shows ~3.4% pass@1 regression. Suspect quant kernel + kv-cache. Recommend int4 vs int8 microbench and eval subset: `eval-harness --subset instruction --models q6b-int4-v2,q6b-int8-v1 --metrics pass@1,exact_match`.

alex: Will produce overlap CSV + dedupe candidates by EOD and run tokenizer-check against baseline.

sara: For gold: propose adding 150 micro-gold hard negatives from disagreements between baseline and new. Better signal for regressions.

maria: Agree. Also want per-route telemetry by prompt shape (length, code-blocks, role tokens). @kevin add panels?

kevin: Will add `instruction_fail_rate`, `token_latency_p50/p95`, and `prompt_shape` tag breakdown to canary dashboard. I'll also post int4/int8 microbench results.

label-bot: queue update: 1189 open, 3 active annotators, est throughput 200/day. Priority 500 ETA ~3 days. For <48h turnaround recommend 2 contractors.

jonathan: If we need coverage without labels, I can synth-augment ~200 paraphrases for rare intents (temp=0.9) to keep signal while deduping.

maria: Action items: 1) alex -> overlap CSV + dedupe list (EOD); 2) jonathan -> synth augment + dedupe script; 3) sara -> golden-update PR + allocate 500 items; 4) kevin -> dashboard panels + microbench; 5) label-bot -> request contractors if ETA>2d. Reconvene Thu 10:00am PT. Pin failing prompts to shared gist/S3 for SRE/support. Thanks :thumbsup:
